title: Home Delivery Pharmacy and Pharmacy Benefit Plan: Payment Plan Length by Benefit Design
content:
## Benefit design crosswalk: plan length

**Rule.** On a Home Delivery Pharmacy payment plan, a plan is lengthened by the design of the member's pharmacy benefit plan: by two months for a high-deductible HSA design, by one month for a deductible-and-copay design, and not at all for a copay-only design.

The design read is the plan design type of the member's active Pharmacy Benefit Plan enrollment.

### Crosswalk

| Design of the active Pharmacy Benefit Plan | Home delivery payment plan lengthened by |
|---|---|
| High-deductible HSA design | 2 months |
| Deductible-and-copay design | 1 month |
| Copay-only design | none |

### Questions answered

**Whose plan design is read?** The member's own active Pharmacy Benefit Plan enrollment, the design their sponsor elected.

**Does a copay-only design lengthen the plan?** No.
